scope: Support the observed AC1032 DataStorage schema-table-role profile whose schema roots and unknown-property headers are split across two schdat segments. This is section parsing evidence, not ACIS/SAB semantics or 3D support qualification.

source.provenance: Tracked ACadSharp sample; the copy under /Users/dli/doc/dwg5 has the same SHA-256.

format_authority.name: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
format_authority.section: §24.2.2.5 describes the first schidx table as unknown-property references and the second as schema-property references; the parser retains the separately observed AC1027-origin reversed-role profile only when its bounded references are self-consistent.

observations.unknown_property_headers: Eight references target local offsets 0, 8, 16, and 24 in each schema-data segment.

implementation.behavior: The existing reversed-table-role detector now validates roots and unknown-property headers per referenced schdat segment, including segment kind, contiguous eight-byte header offsets, per-segment schema-root ordering, and the schema-data alignment boundary. The multi-schdat form is admitted for AC1032 only; the earlier single-schdat AC1027/AC1032 profile remains covered. Malformed roots remain structurally invalid and do not select compatibility.

coverage: two-schdat AC1032 reversed-role profile parses both schemas and both sets of unknown-property headers
out-of-segment root is rejected without selecting compatibility
the same multi-schdat profile is not enabled for AC1027

physical_reader_recheck.before: DataStorage rejected with 14 schema unknown-property offset diagnostics; read stopped at DWG error 9 and 0/842 source frames were published.
physical_reader_recheck.after: DWG read operation succeeds, publishes 837/842 observed frames, has zero entity parse failures and five object parse failures, and reports zero DataStorage link failures or orphan records.
physical_reader_recheck.next_gate: Strict DXF output still refuses before serialization because IMAGEDEF/reactor source capture or immutable-payload correlation fails. The sample also has five object parse failures. No complete conversion or 3D semantic claim follows.

validation.fixture_policy: The ACadSharp DWG was used read-only and was not copied into this repository. The generated two-segment vector is created in memory by the existing focused CTest.
